thread:
alex: Quick follow-up on pinning semantics: need a clear wire schema and controller rules for under-capacity cases.

nora: We used 'intent' in the RFC but didn't define behavior. Do we do soft/hard or soft/sticky/hard?

sam: Ops prefers 2 modes but 3 reflects runtime affordances. If we pick 3, make controller behavior explicit.

kai: Proposal: pin_mode in {soft, sticky, hard}. Define: soft=advisory, sticky=prefer until TTL/evictable, hard=reject if not satisfiable.

maria: Add fallback_policy so clients can request controller downgrade vs reject. Also add optional probe_set for rollout correlation.

alex: Version IDs: require canonical_id (content hash) for enforcement, alias allowed for UX. Controller resolves alias->canonical_id at acceptance and stores canonical_id.

sam: Legacy: map old "pin":true -> pin_mode=sticky, lease_ttl=3600, fallback_policy=downgrade_to_sticky. Document tests.
kai: Example wire schema (human JSON):
```json
{
  "pin_mode": "sticky",
  "fallback_policy": "downgrade_to_sticky",
  "alias": "model-1.2.0",
  "canonical_id": "sha256:...",
  "lease_ttl": 3600,
  "pin_source": "client",
  "probe_set": "smoke_v1"
}
```

maria: Metrics: pin_requests_total{mode,result} with result in {satisfied,downgraded,rejected} and trace tag pin_resolution for easy filtering.

alex: Action items: 1) finalize schema fields 2) controller rejection semantics (409 payloads) 3) compatibility doc 4) telemetry+metrics 5) quota checks and owner-override flow.

deploy-bot: canary deploy of pin-schema-shim v0.3 succeeded in us-west-2 :white_check_mark:

nora: I'll draft the compatibility tests.
kai: I'll mock alias resolution.
sam: I'll write the error responses.
maria: I'll add telemetry tickets.
alex: Thanks — paste PR links here when ready. :thumbsup:
